Q1: The file list leaves out `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, but step 3 asks to update its comment near line 33218. Which instruction applies?
Choices:
A. Add `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` to the allowed files, for a comment-only change at lines 33217-33224 that adds `ai:workflow-heal-escalated` to the listed latch labels. No code change in that file. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Keep the strict file list. Leave `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` untouched, even though its comment will no longer list every latch label.
C. Keep the strict file list, but rewrite only the comment in `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` so it says that the poller comment at `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` line 33218 lists only the original two labels.
